title: ClimaX: A foundation model for weather and climate
layout_note: One horizontal strip: groups of small field patches, one group per variable, each group named by a square bracket underneath; coloured arcs over the top link the patches at the same spatial position across groups.
grouping: Grouping is by brackets only: a flat square bracket under each run of patches, labelled with the variable name (T2m, U500, Q850). Ellipses inside a group stand for the omitted patches and a larger ellipsis between groups for omitted variables. Each arc colour (blue, green, purple) is one spatial position.
shapes_depth: The patches are small square crops of the actual fields in a red-white-blue diverging colormap, flat with no border; the first patch is sized by italic p labels on its left and bottom edges. Arcs are thick smooth curves in three saturated colours with no arrowheads. No boxes or network shapes at all.
proposed_highlight: The operation is shown only by the arcs: what gets aggregated is whatever one arc colour touches, so the colour carries the mechanism and no block is drawn for it.
lesson: Show aggregation across variables at one location by drawing one coloured arc per patch position that links the matching patches in every variable group, with the groups named by brackets underneath.
notes: venue = arXiv: the PDF carries only a date header and names no venue (an ICML 2023 version is recalled but not confirmed by anything read here; venue_source: unverified). year = arXiv preprint year (2301.10343). The field patches are embedded images recorded by refs crop and left out of the palette. Annotation note (2026-11-15): Module-detail crop only (cross-variable patch grouping); no inputs/outputs or model boxes, so limited as a whole-method skeleton.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

taxonomy.note: Crop shows only the variable-grouping / cross-variable aggregation detail; training is not depicted (ClimaX pretrains by forecasting).

core.what: one horizontal strip of field-map patches grouped per variable (T2m, U500, Q850, closed by brackets underneath), with one coloured arc per patch position arching over the strip to join the patch at that position in every variable group

relations.form: the data are drawn as real red-blue colormapped field patches, the first one annotated p x p, with ellipses between patches and between groups
three arcs (blue, green, purple) each link the same-position patch across the variable groups, without arrowheads or a target node

channels.colour: arc colour = patch position (blue first, green second, purple last); red-blue in the tiles is the field colormap
channels.shape: square tiles = patches; brackets = variable groups
channels.frame: square brackets under each group name the variable

quality.strengths: Patches are real field tiles and the variable groups are named by brackets, and colour is used for one thing only (which spatial position an arc links).
quality.weaknesses: The arcs overlap and cross between groups and end on no node, so what the aggregation produces is not drawn; the long arcs span the whole width; without the caption the reader cannot tell that the arcs mean grouping by location rather than a sequence.

insights.structure: One horizontal strip of field-map patches grouped per variable (T2m, U500, Q850), each group closed by a square bracket labelled underneath, with ellipses between patches and between groups.
insights.data: Each patch is a small red-blue colormapped field tile (real data), with a p x p size annotation on the first tile.
insights.emphasis: Coloured arcs (blue, green, purple) arch over the strip connecting the patch at the same spatial position in every variable group, so the cross-variable link is the only coloured element.
insights.flow: Left to right along the strip; arcs run over the top, one hue per patch position, without arrowheads.
insights.avoid: Arcs overlap and cross each other between groups and have no arrowheads or target, so what the aggregation produces is not shown; the figure is unreadable without its caption.

arrangement.units: one strip; sub-groups are variable groups marked by brackets below, not frames
